digest.component_or_area: rebar tracker-footprint command and measurement infrastructure
propositions: Add an explicit opt-in read-only rebar tracker-footprint command that measures Git pack bytes, checkout logical bytes, checkout allocated bytes, and whole-clone footprint separately without running implicitly from ticket writes or CI gates.

The command must distinguish between mounted tracker object stores (labeled shared) and fresh-clone temporary measurements (labeled standalone), ensuring Git object database sharing is not misrepresented as standalone clone cost.

Output must report packed object bytes, checkout logical and allocated bytes (when st_blocks is available), file count, allocation slack, Git-directory bytes, and whole-clone bytes in both text and schema-validated JSON format.

Fresh-clone mode must resolve a configured tickets remote and branch, create a temporary single-branch unfiltered clone with local hardlink optimization disabled, measure it, and remove only the temporary directory even on failure.

Platform edges including missing st_blocks support and linked worktrees must be handled by reporting structured unavailable values rather than fabricated zeros, without threshold logic or size-based exit status changes.
Hard footprint budgets, shrink-only ratchets, scheduled triggers, and CI gates are explicitly rejected in favor of pure descriptive measurement that never blocks unrelated work.
